chunks: And We bestowed upon David, Solomon; an excellent servant, indeed he was one who turned back [to God].

key_terms.أَوَّابٌ: One who frequently turns back (to God in repentance/devotion)

ai.seo_question: What does the title 'Awwab' signify regarding Prophet Solomon's character in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Solomon’s spiritual perfection through the attribute of 'Awwab', denoting a servant who consistently returns to God with humility and devotion. This status is often linked to his unique combination of prophetic authority and kingship, serving as a model for righteous leadership. The emphasis on frequent repentance highlights the continuous nature of spiritual refinement even for the most elevated prophets.
